cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,json,base64,subprocess
h='type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload\n'
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[],'services':[],'queries':[0],'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(h.encode()).decode()]},{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['']}],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
# second capture empty string chunks -> empty stream -> capture error, not header only. Use split header second too.
job['captures'][1]={'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(h.encode()).decode()]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/campaign.py'],input=json.dumps(job).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print(p.stdout)
EOF
